rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Huntress integration enables AI assistants to interact with the Huntress managed security platform. It provides seven functional domains—accounts, agents, organizations, incidents, billing, signals, and user management—using hierarchical tool navigation. Built by WYRE Technology, the server implements HTTP Basic Auth, built-in rate limiting, and supports MCPB bundle, Docker, and npm installation, with 11 releases through April 2026.
